metric.description: Precision/recall F1 over peaks matched by reciprocal overlap. A candidate peak and a reference peak count as the same region when each covers at least the required fraction of the other, so a call that is shifted or much wider than the reference does not match. Matching is one-to-one, so splitting one reference peak into several candidate peaks cannot be rewarded more than once.

route.provenance: calibrated from a complete frozen-input BWA-MEM 0.7.19 plus MACS3 3.0.4 execution record after verifying the requested fastp filtering, valid paired-end hg19 alignment, MAPQ 30 and mitochondrial filtering, duplicate removal, q-value 0.05 peak calling without a control, and the final BED projection.
